Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/2761/2021

Dear Ms. Patel,

Thank you for meeting us on 24/10/2021 about your dispute with Harish Swamy. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Bengaluru.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Bengaluru
